name: Just Poleaxe
description:
Adds a craftable poleaxe, capable of dealing all three slash/blunt/pierce damage; high AP, armour&building damage.
[list]
[*][b]Requires Melee 25 to use[/b]
[*]Unlocked from research [b]Axes II[/b]
[*]Crafted at the [b]Blacksmith Forge with Smithing 25[/b]
[*]Materials available: [b]Steel[/b], [b]Gold[/b], or [b]Silver[/b]
[*][b]IMPORTANT: untick other metals (such as iron ingot) in the production recipe, otherwise your ingredients will vanish.[/b]
[*][b]IMPORTANT: disable other metal materials (such as iron ingot) in the production recipe, otherwise your ingredients will gone.[/b]
[*][b]IMPORTANT: cancel other metallistics usage (such as iron ingot) in the production recipe, otherwise your ingredients will disappear.[/b]
[/list]
